dbadmin.config.title: DBAdmin
dbadmin.config.persistColumnLayout: Keep column hide/order/width even when tabs are not auto-restored.
dbadmin.config.pgAdminBinPath: Path to the pgAdmin binaries directory (pg_dump, pg_restore). Leave empty to detect automatically.
dbadmin.config.showFilterLabel: Show the table filter label at the top of DBAdmin when a filter is active.
dbadmin.config.defaultPageSize: Default number of items per page in the table view.
dbadmin.config.managerPollIntervalSecond: Auto-refresh interval (seconds) for the Manage connection panel. Min 1s, max 60s.
dbadmin.config.managerTimeWindowMinutes: Time window for Manage connection charts, in minutes. 0 = unlimited (series grows without dropping points).
dbadmin.config.dynamicDefaultColumnWidth: When enabled, default column width is computed from visible content. When disabled, uses a fixed width (170).
dbadmin.config.expandFilterResults: When enabled, typing in the table filter collapses and expands matching results in the tree.
dbadmin.config.mcpAllowWrites: Allow the MCP server to run write SQL (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL). Default is read-only.
dbadmin.config.mcpMaxRows: Maximum number of rows returned by the MCP query tool.
dbadmin.config.sqlbook.title: SQLBook
dbadmin.config.sqlbookIntegratedTable: Show the integrated table in SQL Book (inline cell result instead of opening the panel).
dbadmin.config.sqlbookRunPerQuery: Show a Run button on each query when a SQL Book cell has two or more statements (separated by semicolon or blank line).
dbadmin.mcpProvider.label: DBAdmin
